assessment.topic: Principal reference entity versus authenticated principal kind
assessment.evidence: policy.rs derives RoleBindingContract.principal from a referenced identity entity or the record's own identity entity; membership.principal comes from the member field's referenced entity. The new principal_entity label represents that source entity, not a user/service authenticated principal kind or live caller. Independent CLI output confirms User for Company.owner_id and Service for ApplicationServiceMembership. It does not fabricate principal declarations or effective role membership.

Role identities use Entity.field and membership identities use Entity; both collections are BTreeMaps before array serialization. Fields/names retain checked semantic spelling. Role/model declarations are unique on a checked project; malformed source cannot masquerade as an empty inventory. Membership rows appear ApplicationMembership, ApplicationServiceMembership, CompanyMembership even though CompanyMembership appears first in the authored fixture. Decision keys are a BTreeSet; decision IDs hash category plus identity, independent of change direction. Renames remain remove/add and are not represented as durable identity equivalence.
